"""PocketCoffea configuration snippet: analysis categories as the cartesian
product of jet-multiplicity and b-tag-multiplicity binnings.

Requires: pocket-coffea==0.9.13
"""

from pocket_coffea.lib.cut_functions import get_nObj_eq, get_nObj_min
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianSelection

# Binning 1: jet multiplicity (JetGood) -> exactly 4, exactly 5, at least 6
njet_binning = MultiCut(
    name="Njet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(4, coll="JetGood"),
        get_nObj_eq(5, coll="JetGood"),
        get_nObj_min(6, coll="JetGood"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["4j", "5j", "6j"],
)

# Binning 2: b-tag multiplicity (BJetGood) -> exactly 2, at least 3
nbjet_binning = MultiCut(
    name="Nbjet",
    cuts=[
        get_nObj_eq(2, coll="BJetGood"),
        get_nObj_min(3, coll="BJetGood"),
    ],
    cuts_names=["2b", "3b"],
)

# Cartesian combination of the two binnings -> 3 x 2 = 6 categories:
# 4j_2b, 4j_3b, 5j_2b, 5j_3b, 6j_2b, 6j_3b
categories = CartesianSelection(
    multicuts=[njet_binning, nbjet_binning],
)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    combined_names = [
        f"{njet}_{nbjet}"
        for njet in njet_binning.cuts_names
        for nbjet in nbjet_binning.cuts_names
    ]
    print(f"Defined {len(combined_names)} categories: {combined_names}")
